name: ktav-lang/ktav
description: PHP bindings for Ktav — a plain configuration format with three rules, zero indentation, and no required quoting (quoted keys are supported). FFI over the reference Rust crate (default) plus a full pure-PHP parser/writer backend (requires only ext-json, no FFI or native binary); no extension compilation on the consumer side.

suggest.ext-ffi: Required only for the default native backend; the pure backend (Ktav\PureBackend) needs none.
